elements.description: The message box of an AI chat: model picker, voice input, attachments, connecting apps and requesting approval.

properties.name: models
properties.default: [ { id: "auto", name: "Auto", description: "Picks the best model for each task" }, { id: "claude", name: "Claude", description: "Thoughtful writing and code" }, { id: "chatgpt", name: "ChatGPT", description: "Quick answers for everyday tasks" }, ]
properties.description: Models in the picker; the first one is selected by default. An empty list disables the picker

properties.name: model
properties.description: Id of the selected model – unset, or one that's no longer in the list, selects the first

properties.name: loadMs
properties.description: How long "Connect apps" and "Request approval" load at least, in ms

properties.name: dictation
properties.default: "Draft a short update for the team about this week's progress"
properties.description: Sample transcript that appears word by word while recording when there's no onDictate

properties.name: demo
properties.description: Demo mode: connecting apps, requesting approval and dictation are simulated silently where their handlers are missing

properties.name: onDictate
properties.description:
Live speech-to-text for the mic, called when recording starts. Push the transcript so far with `onTranscript`
(and the input level, 0–1, with `onLevel` for the trace); stop listening when `signal` aborts – on Discard,
Use recording or removal. A rejection ends the recording with an error. Without it a sample transcript plays

properties.name: onSend
properties.type: ((message: string, details: { model: string }) => void | Promise<unknown>) | undefined
properties.description:
Sends the message. Return a promise to keep the message (and a pending send button) until it settles: it is
cleared when it resolves and kept, with an error, when it rejects

properties.name: onConnectApps
properties.description: Connects the user's apps; "Connect apps" keeps loading until a returned promise settles. Without it connecting is simulated

properties.name: onRequestApproval
properties.description: Requests unrestricted access – resolves, rejects and is simulated like onConnectApps

properties.name: mentions
properties.description: Opt-in: the / and @ picker on the message (tc-mention-picker). Its tc-pick bubbles from the composer

properties.name: context
properties.description:
Opt-in: what's in context, as chips above the composer (tc-context-tray). Changes come as tc-items-change; the
composer keeps the new list unless a listener prevents it

properties.name: contextLimit
properties.description: The context window the tray measures against, in tokens

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-value-change
events.description: The message changed (`{ value: string }`) – typing, dictation, clearing after a send; cancelable – prevent it to keep `value` (controlled use)

events.name: tc-model-change
events.description: A model was picked in the menu (`{ model: string; choice: ChatModel }`); cancelable

events.name: tc-send
events.description: A message was sent (`{ message: string; model: string }`); `onSend` may return a promise to keep it until it settles

events.name: tc-attach
events.description: The plus button was pressed – open your own file or folder picker here

events.name: tc-connect-apps
events.description: "Connect apps" was pressed; `onConnectApps` may return a promise it waits for

events.name: tc-request-approval
events.description: "Request approval" was pressed; `onRequestApproval` may return a promise it waits for

props.name: value
props.description: The message (controlled). Leave undefined to let the composer keep it, starting at `defaultValue`

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The message to start with when uncontrolled

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Every change to the message – typing, dictation, clearing after a send

props.name: models
props.description: Models in the picker; the first one is selected by default. An empty list disables the picker

props.name: model
props.description: Id of the selected model (controlled). Leave undefined to let the composer keep it

props.name: defaultModel
props.description: Id of the model selected at first when uncontrolled – defaults to the first model

props.name: onModelChange
props.description: Reports the model picked in the menu – with `model` set, also the only way the selection changes

props.name: onAttach
props.description: The plus button only reports the click – open your own file or folder picker here

props.name: context
props.description:
Opt-in: what's in context, as chips above the composer (controlled). Leave undefined to let it keep the list,
starting at `defaultContext` – or leave both unset for no tray

props.name: onContextChange
props.description: Every change to the context chips: removed, restored, pinned

props.name: onMentionPick
props.description: A row picked in the / and @ picker (set `mentions` to turn it on); call event.preventDefault() to keep the text

changelog: chat-composer (the Lit element and `trenchcoat/react`): opt-in `mentions` (a `tc-mention-picker` on the message) and `context` / `context-limit` (a `tc-context-tray` above it). Without them it renders as before.
